description: This file defines the EmployeeQualificationsController class within the OrangeHRM PIM plugin, responsible for handling employee qualifications views, particularly preparing and rendering the Vue component for employee language and competency data.

classes.name: EmployeeQualificationsController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing employee qualifications view, initializing Vue component with employee language and competency data, and setting permissions based on employee ID.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with employee qualifications data if empNumber is provided, sets component properties for fluencies and competencies, and permissions for editing qualifications.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns a list of qualification-related data groups to check for employee capability permissions.
